ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $PA$, $PB$ are tangent to the circle $\odot O$ at points $A$, $B$ respectively, and point $C$ is on the circle $\odot O$. If $\angle C = 70^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle P$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OA and OB, \\
$\because PA$ and $PB$ are tangents to $\odot O$, \\
$\therefore PA\perp OA$, $PB\perp OB$, \\
$\therefore \angle PAO=\angle PBO=90^\circ$, \\
$\because \angle P+\angle PAO+\angle AOB+\angle PBO=360^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle P=180^\circ-\angle AOB$, \\
$\because \angle C=70^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle AOB=2\angle C=140^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle P=180^\circ-140^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
